verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS recruiting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or opt-out settings. The cited items cover API endpoints, webhooks, the MCP server and recruiting features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
